message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore’s presentation on climate science, followed by a global tour of the impacts of warming. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film, featuring new data and policy discussions. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to witness climate change’s effects and meets scientists, activists, and leaders. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC documentary that breaks down the science, economics, and politics behind global warming. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from science, business, and faith communities. |
| **“Our Planet” (Season 1)** | 2019 | While not solely about climate change, this nature series highlights how warming threatens ecosystems worldwide. |

All of these are available on major streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or YouTube). If you’d like more details on any particular film or help finding where to stream it, just let me know!
